isolation.note: The scenario definition itself lives outside the permitted evidence tree, so the cast/option wiring was reconstructed from the scenario name plus the cached wiki text and the cached champion-audit records under data/.

step_1_scenario_decoding.claim: '_120' is the Syndra champion option 'splinters' set to its maximum, 120 Splinters of Wrath (not a level, not a duration).
support: data/champions.json Syndra P Transcendent: 'Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath ... stacking up to 120 times.' and 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.' -- 120 is the documented cap of exactly one Syndra quantity.
data/champion-audit/batch-6.json (Syndra): 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff'.
data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json (Syndra): 'E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage)'.

derivation: Q Dark Sphere - damaging active: 'Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location ... dealing magic damage to nearby enemies' (90/125/160/195/230 +70% AP).

Q2 - the SECOND Dark Sphere charge. Wiki Transcendent Bonus on Q: 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' 120 >= 40, so two Q casts are available inside one rotation and the second charge is a distinct timeline source (the audit calls it the 'synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)' slot: module_slots.modeled = [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R]).

W Force of Will recast - 'Syndra throws the grabbed target ... dealing magic damage' (70/100/130/160/190 +65% AP), plus at 60+ splinters '12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage' -- still one source named W.
E Scatter the Weak - 'deals magic damage to enemies hit' (60/95/130/165/200 +60% AP). Its 80-splinter Transcendent Bonus is scatter angle + 70% slow, i.e. utility only: it adds no new damage source.

R Unleashed Power - 'she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit' (80/120/160 +20% AP per sphere). Its 100-splinter Transcendent Bonus is an execute below 15% max health, documented as not modeled ('the fight target never dies'), so it adds no new source either.
P Transcendent contributes only the +15% AP buff at 120 splinters -- a stat buff, not a damage source, so it is not an entry in the source list.
step_2_damage_source_set_at_120_splinter.castability_check: Full 120-splinter rotation mana cost = Q 60 + Q2 60 + W 100 + E 50 + R 100 = 370. Syndra mana at level 18 = 480 + 40 x 17 x (0.7025 + 0.0175 x 17) = 1160 (level 20: 1266.6), and P additionally restores 20:255 (based on level) mana per collected Splinter. The five-cast rotation including the second Dark Sphere charge is comfortably castable, so nothing suppresses Q2.

step_3_index_resolution.reasoning: timeline_coverage partitions the fight's damage sources into exact_sources (authored event timing) vs coarse_sources (no authored timing) -- see data/worklists/e9-bis-a-task.md ('timeline_coverage complete==true, coarse_sources==[]') and data/worklists/e9-bis-b-task.md ('coarse sources with no authored event timing'). Every Syndra slot is an authored, sourced single-hit/multi-sphere event, so all five damage sources land in exact_sources and none in coarse_sources. Ordering the source list canonically (ascending) gives ['E','Q','Q2','R','W'], whose element 3 is 'R'.
step_3_index_resolution.old_value_explanation: The old leaf value 'W' is exactly what the same list yields when the second Dark Sphere charge is missing: sorted(['Q','W','E','R']) = ['E','Q','R','W'], element 3 = 'W'. The old snapshot therefore encodes a Syndra timeline at 120 splinters that never fired the 40-splinter Q charge -- the precise mechanic the '_120' scenario exists to exercise. Adding the wiki-mandated Q2 source shifts element 3 from 'W' to 'R', which is the observed change.
step_3_index_resolution.cast_order_cross_check: Under the alternative reading that exact_sources is in cast order rather than sorted order, the answer is still 'R' for any ultimate-last Syndra rotation (Q, W, E, R / E, Q, W, R / Q, E, W, R all put R at index 3). The only cast-order shapes that put W at index 3 require the ultimate to be cast before W, or require a non-damaging P entry to be occupying index 0 -- and in the latter case removing that spurious entry is itself the correct fix. Both readings converge on 'R'.

sources_quoted.quote: Innate: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, stacking up to 120 times.
At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.
Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target towards the target location ... dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies once they land.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak to have an increased scatter angle and slow enemies hit by 70% for 1.25 seconds ...

Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances Unleashed Power to execute the target if it would damage them to below 15% of their maximum health.

modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge). P = 120-splinter +15% total AP BUFF. ... splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff; R reads 'Magic Damage per Sphere' x user-set sphere count. The one damage.execute atom (R at 100 splinters ...) is explicitly documented as not modeled.
EXPLICIT_APPLICABILITY_EXCLUSION_SOURCES ... coarse sources with no authored event timing.

sources_quoted.path: Section 5, formula-audit table row 'Ability rotation casts'
sources_quoted.quote: shared-timeline renewal schedule; cast starts within window | EXACT | ... R single-cast

each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (_schedule_shared_casts) ... resolved greedily by cast order.

confidence: high on the domain fact (at 120 Splinters Syndra has two Dark Sphere charges, so a second Q damage source belongs in the timeline and 'W' cannot be the fourth exact source); medium-high on the exact index mechanics, since the scenario definition and timeline_coverage implementation are outside the permitted evidence tree. Both the sorted-list reading and the cast-order reading of exact_sources land on 'R'.
caveats: The scenario's literal cast order and champion_options could not be read under runbook isolation; the decoding of 'custom_order_120' rests on the Syndra option surface documented in data/champion-audit/*.json plus the wiki text.
Only the leaf's categorical value was checked. No numeric damage total in the same subtree was verified by this receipt.
